parsed.visual_overview: A young woman in a graduation gown delivers a confident, tough-love stage monologue from a wooden podium. The video cuts briefly to a screencast of the Supernova AI app interface showing an AI avatar, and later to an app store installation screen. It ends with the presenter delivering a final call-to-action with an on-screen install prompt.

characters.name: Priya
characters.brief: Young adult Indian female in a black graduation gown, delivering an authoritative, confident speech.

scenes.scene_brief: Presenter delivers a speech from a podium, calling out the viewer's daily phone habits.
scenes.supernova_script:
Priya says: What do you do when you wake up in the morning? Instagram.
Priya says: Before going to sleep at night? Reels.
Priya says: In between? Reels again.
Priya says: You scroll for four hours every day, but you can't find 15 minutes for English?
Priya says: This is your mistake.
Priya says: I am not saying don't use your phone.
Priya says: Just take out 15 minutes from those four hours.
Priya says: Download Supernova AI.

scenes.scene_brief: App screencast showing the AI teacher interface with a robotic avatar and control buttons.
scenes.supernova_script: Priya says: You get a personal AI teacher right on your phone,

scenes.scene_brief: Presenter continues her stage speech, emphasizing the value of 15 minutes of practice.
scenes.supernova_script:
Priya says: who lets you practice real speaking, corrects your mistakes live, and explains the logic in your own language.
Priya says: In the time it takes to watch one reel, you can learn to speak a proper sentence.
Priya says: Reels give you nothing, but these 15 minutes can change your future.
Priya says: You ask, "How do I practice? No one speaks English at home."
Priya says: On Supernova AI, your AI teacher is available 24/7.
Priya says: You can make a thousand mistakes, and she will never judge or laugh at you.
Priya says: Over 1 crore users are already learning this way.
Priya says: "I'll do it later"—you've been saying this for years.
Priya says: But you can actually see improvement in just 30 days.
Priya says: Plus, it is seven times cheaper than offline coaching.
Priya says: Because the one who practices 15 minutes every day, goes ahead.

scenes.scene_brief: App store screencast showing the app in the process of installing.
scenes.supernova_script: Priya says: It is time to take action.

scenes.scene_brief: Presenter concludes her speech as a final call-to-action overlay appears.
scenes.supernova_script: Priya says: Click the install button, download Supernova AI today, and start speaking English right now!
